description: A furniture piece whose `tags` member is the strings U+FB01, "z", U+1F600 and "A": a `terms` value is sorted as sequences of UTF-16 code units (9.7), so U+1F600 - the surrogates 0xD83D 0xDE00 - comes before U+FB01, although its code point is the larger; and the display lists them in the same order.
